sn22.64:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || pe || pahitatto vihareyyan ti || || Maññamāno kho bhikkhu baddho Mārassa || amaññamāno mutto pāpimato hoti || || Aññātam Bhagavā aññātaṃ Sugatāti || ||
sn22.64:2.1: Yathā katham pana tvam bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsīti || || Rūpaṃ kho bhante maññamāno baddho Mārassa || amaññamāno mutto pāpimato || || Vedanaṃ || || Saññaṃ || || Saṅkhāre || || Viññāṇam maññamāno baddho Mārassa || amaññamāno mutto pāpimato || || Imassa khvāham bhante Bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti || ||
sn22.64:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhu || sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena attham ājānāsi || || Rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu maññamāno baddho Mārassa || amaññamāno mutto pāpimato || || Vedanaṃ || || Saññaṃ || || Saṅkhāre || || Viññāṇaṃ maññamāno baddho Mārassa || amaññamāno mutto pāpimato || || Imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo ti || || ||Pa || Aññataro ca so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti || ||
